convert_torchvision_to_d2: run the script to convert a torchvision ResNet .pth model file to a Detectron2 .pkl weight file
rename_torchvision_keys: run the script to rename torchvision layer keys like layer1 to res2 and bn1 to conv1.norm for Detectron2
detach_and_numpy_convert: run the script to detach tensors and convert them to numpy arrays for pickle serialization
stem_prefix_keys: run the script to prefix non-layer keys with stem. for Detectron2 backbone compatibility
check_unconverted_keys: run the script and print any unconverted keys remaining after the torchvision to Detectron2 conversion
